answer.new_information: The record is a GeForce NOW consumer gaming update: 12 new cloud games including Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains, Summer Sale discounts of $35 on a 12-month Performance membership and $70 on a 12-month Ultimate membership, and one unnamed member's calculated monthly cost drop from roughly 29 CAD to 17 CAD. It has no link to NVIDIA's cloud-provider capacity-purchase or lease guarantees, the revenue-sharing program, or the OpenAI Ohio lease, so it does not bear on v1 or v2 and carries no figure, period or definition that matches either question.
